title: Tennis: Alex Eala looks to keep climbing after ending 2026 as world No. 15
summary: Filipina tennis star Alex Eala fulfilled her goal for 2026 by making it to the top 20 of the WTA rankings, even surpassing her initial target as she ended the year as world No. 15.
